_**Agent (composer-2.5)**_

Proof sections are now foldable. Here's what changed:

1. **`_plugins/mathbox.rb`** — `{% proof %}` blocks render as a native `<details>` element instead of a static div. The "Proof." label is the clickable summary; the body stays hidden until expanded.

2. **`_sass/_distill.scss`** — Added styles for the foldable proof (chevron indicator, pointer cursor, spacing when open) and excluded `.mathbox` from the generic `details` styling so proofs keep their mathbox look.

Your existing markup stays the same:

```liquid
{% proof %}
...
{% endproof %}
```

Proofs start **collapsed** by default. Click "▸ Proof." to expand.

**Note:** Because this changes a Jekyll plugin, restart `bundle exec jekyll serve --drafts` for it to take effect. SCSS changes should hot-reload on their own.

If you'd rather proofs start expanded, or only certain proofs foldable, say the word.
